^(api_key_env)$.description:
The name of the environment variable that holds the provider's API
 key, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: required in the API key mode, and
 refused in the sign-in mode. pumi run reads the key from it, which
 must not be empty.

^(read_paths)$.description:
Absolute paths outside the workspace that the commands of the adapter's
 harness may read, such as a toolchain or a module cache. The runner
 passes them in each invocation; pumi refuses a path that is not
 absolute (decision 0269).

apiKeyEnv.description:
The name of the environment variable that holds the provider's API
 key, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: required in the API key mode, and
 refused in the sign-in mode. pumi run reads the key from it, which
 must not be empty.

executable.description:
The executable, relative to the directory of the configuration file
 or absolute (decision 0158).

readPaths.description:
Absolute paths outside the workspace that the commands of the adapter's
 harness may read, such as a toolchain or a module cache. The runner
 passes them in each invocation; pumi refuses a path that is not
 absolute (decision 0269).

sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the executable, in lowercase hexadecimal. The runner
 refuses to start an executable whose SHA-256 differs.

pumi.config.v1.Fallback.jsonschema.json.description:
Fallback is the adapter and model that a model role falls back to
 (decision 0246).
pumi.config.v1.Fallback.jsonschema.json.title: Fallback

pumi.config.v1.Models.jsonschema.json.description:
Models is the model configuration (decision 0245): which adapter and
 model serve each model role, and their fallbacks.

^(check_adapter)$.description:
The adapter that runs every check and external action, which name no
 model role (decision 0253).

adapters.description: The adapters by name, such as "claude-code" and "codex".

checkAdapter.description:
The adapter that runs every check and external action, which name no
 model role (decision 0253).

roles.description:
The model roles by name, such as "frontier". Each model role that the
 workflow names must be here (decision 0233).

pumi.config.v1.Models.jsonschema.json.title: Models

pumi.config.v1.Role.jsonschema.json.description:
Role is the adapter and model of a model role, and its fallback
 (decisions 0233, 0245 and 0246).

adapter.description: The adapter that runs the role's agent runs.

fallback.description:
The fallback, which may be on another adapter; none when not set.
 When it is on the same adapter, the model gateway also sends a call
 once to its model when the provider answers with a usage or rate limit
 (decision 0233). When it is on another adapter, the runner starts that
 adapter once when the provider's limit stops a run of the role, and the
 role stays on its fallback until pumi role reset switches it back
 (decision 0246).

pumi.config.v1.Role.jsonschema.json.title: Role
